title: Automation becomes envelopes with the same ramps, steps, jumps and octave sweeps
description:
As a producer, I want the score's automation as envelopes in the set, so that fades and sweeps play and can be edited there.

```gherkin
Feature: Automation becomes envelopes
  Background:
    Given the score "sweep.apr":
      """
      tempo 120
      key C
      clip stab = stab.wav
      bars 8
      track stab  steps "x . x . x . x ."  filter lp 20000
        eq    highcut 20k
        comp  3:1  -22dB  mix 0%
        automate volume      1=-60dB  2=0dB
        automate comp.mix    step  1=0%  5=100%
        automate eq.highcut  1=20k  3=6k  5=5k
      """

  Scenario: A fade in on the track's volume
    When I export "sweep.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the track "stab" has a volume envelope from -60 dB at bar 1 to 0 dB at bar 2

  Scenario: A step holds its value until the next point
    When I export "sweep.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the Compressor's dry/wet envelope on "stab" is 0% until bar 5 and 100% from bar 5 on

  Scenario: A frequency sweep moves by octaves
    When I export "sweep.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the EQ Eight high cut envelope on "stab" passes 20 kHz at bar 1, 6 kHz at bar 3 and 5 kHz at bar 5
    And halfway between bars 1 and 3 it is within a quarter tone of 11 kHz

  Scenario: Values hold before the first point and after the last
    When I export "sweep.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the EQ Eight high cut envelope on "stab" stays at 5 kHz from bar 5 to the end

  Scenario: Two points at one position jump
    Given the track "stab" has "automate pan 3=-50 3=50"
    When I export "sweep.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the pan envelope on "stab" jumps from 50% left to 50% right at bar 3
```
